item.title: BJD to protest over ‘farmers’ plights, poor law and order scenario’ in Odisha
item.description: Bhubaneswar: BJD has slammed Odisha’s BJP government over the alleged plight of farmers and deteriorating law and order situation across the state, and decided to go for a fortnight-long statewide agitation next month.
